issues.description: Visibility mismatch for Farm.singFarmSongVerse(animal: Animal): In the problem statement UML the method is declared as private (indicated by '-') while the reference solution implements it as protected. The template's Farm.java currently declares a private singFarmSongVerse method but its parameter is commented out. This inconsistency between the UML/specification and the solution/template can confuse students about the intended visibility (and whether tests will need to access the method).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the intended visibility explicit and consistent across artifacts. Either (A) update the problem statement/UML to declare singFarmSongVerse as protected (or package-private) to match the solution and allow test access, or (B) change the solution (and template stub) to implement the method as private to match the UML and adjust any tests that require access. Prefer updating the UML/problem text to 'protected' if tests need to call the method.
